**Build passes now, exit 0.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

`[options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6)` read `options.retries`, but the bundler now sends `retryCount`. It threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')`. `[retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7)` threw on unset flags, which the new loader leaves as `undefined`. That now means off.

The 8 warnings left are all deprecation notices. Worth a cleanup pass later.
